conflictResolutions.conflict: QRP prose says D4 after observation while Story 2.5b canonical enters recovering after D4
conflictResolutions.resolution: 2.5b D4 execution confirmation enters recovering; 2.5c revalidates persisted approval evidence and requires a fresh execution confirmation before eligible

conflictResolutions.conflict: preview mentions actionable windows before recoveryCompletedAt exists
conflictResolutions.resolution: 2.5b preview is non-authorizing classification using trustedNow plus observationDuration; 2.5c makes the final <= latestActionableAt decision using actual recoveryCompletedAt

conflictResolutions.conflict: RFP request permission could be mistaken for D4 approval
conflictResolutions.resolution: RFP only proves maker request eligibility; identity-access HRAP receipt independently proves checker approval

conflictResolutions.conflict: cross-owner token and recovery transaction could partially commit
conflictResolutions.resolution: identity-access atomically redeems the token into one durable bound execution-authorization lease and executionJti; ingestion-quality atomically consumes that JTI in its owner transaction, confirms through outbox, never reactivates an expired or cancelled token/lease, and reconciles a revocation race back to fused before any downstream business consumption
